what.text: This page follows Afghans in Iran whom UNHCR counts as other people in need of international protection, a group separate from refugees.
At the end of 2025 there were 879500 people in this group, 85.3% of all Afghans in it worldwide.
UNHCR also counted 758339 Afghan refugees in Iran that year, in a separate series.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Afghanistan from 2020 to 2025, at war level in 2020 and 2021.
The groups involved include the Taleban, the High Council of Afghanistan Islamic Emirate, the NRF and the AFF.
UCDP also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2020 to 2025, and an interstate conflict between Afghanistan and Pakistan in 2024 and 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's figures for this group in Iran start in 2025.
In the separate refugee series, Afghan refugees in Iran peaked at 3752317 in 2023.
Returns from Iran to Afghanistan were highest in 2025, at 1386970 in that year.

how.text: These are year-end totals reported to UNHCR.
The sources don't say why the refugee figure for Iran was much lower in 2025 than in 2024, or whether people moved from one group to the other.
People displaced inside Afghanistan are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
